name: a1-marketing-skills
description: Marketing decision support and editorial workflows for AI agents.

interface.longDescription: A portable collection of marketing skills for mapping unclear initiatives, stress-testing decisions, maintaining confirmed context, auditing consumer psychology, and creating or editing source-grounded editorial work.
defaultPrompt: Map this unclear marketing initiative into the decisions we need to make.
Stress-test this marketing plan before we execute it.
Set up marketing context from confirmed repository information.
Edit this marketing copy without changing its facts.
Turn these sources into a useful article or decision memo.
Create a focused promotional page or routine press release from verified facts.
